pairs.subject: narrative-scroll-surface
pairs.evidence: src/app/page.tsx:72 Five of the six landing stages (every HOME_STAGES row with gate: true, client-only via ssr:false in lazy.tsx) mount their content only when an IntersectionObserver fires near the viewport, so the served HTML holds just a label placeholder and crawlers, print, capture and no-script readers never get the page's argument.

techniques.evidence: src/app/page.tsx:72 Reveal is a mounting decision, the failure the technique names: LazyMount renders only a labelled placeholder until the IntersectionObserver fires, and the gated sections are created with ssr:false (lazy.tsx). Only Vision is server-rendered.

src/components/sections/hero-hive/hive-geometry.ts:57 The hero animates a mechanism (event lands, hands off cell to cell, done pillar rises) as an endless 9s CSS keyframe loop with per-element animationDelay clocks. There is no render(t), step or scrub control, and no visible stop control, which the technique requires of a looping mechanism explainer. It does pause off-screen and in a hidden tab, and its reduced-motion still keeps the drawn path and both chips (degraded form 3).

pairs.registryProposal: motion-carries-the-mechanism does not say where an ambient hero loop that depicts a flow as a metaphor (not a step-by-step explainer) stands. The step/scrub/filmstrip obligations read as built for an in-page explainer station, and a seat has to guess whether a first-screen ambient loop owes them or only the stop-control and degraded-form rules.

pairs.subject: narrative-scroll-surface
pairs.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/TopicView.tsx:178 The guide is a document surface (markdown topic body, an 'on this page' TOC, ReadingProgress, prev/next topics) for a reader who came for the content, which the golden path cedes to long-form-reading-surface. A search of src/app/guide found no scroll-bound progress (useScroll, scrollYProgress) and no spine/station structure, only once-per-view whileInView fades on the category grid and Discord CTA.

techniques.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/TopicView.tsx:178 The side index is a document contents panel; the technique's 'When not to use: Documents' clause applies.

src/app/guide/guide-page/GuideCategoryGrid.tsx:33 The grid starts at initial="hidden" and reveals in view, but on a documentation hub, not a narrative page. Its SSR-hidden start state is a defect under the motion and page-load subjects.
src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/TopicView.tsx:164 Topic content is reference prose for a reader who has already decided; the technique excludes those pages.

pairs.registryProposal: The subject does not say whether the landing/hub of a documentation section (a card grid that sells categories to a browsing reader) counts as a narrative surface. Its reveal-without-loss obligations clearly matter there, since crawlers and print lose the SSR-hidden grid, but the precondition only names explanatory pages.

declined.subject: narrative-scroll-surface
declined.reason: This context is locale string bundles plus the language switcher and locale offer. It renders no explanatory page, so the subject plainly does not apply. A not-applicable verdict still cannot pass the directory-level absence re-search, because its directory src/components also holds every landing section: useScroll hits 6 files, scrollYProgress 2, whileInView 23, station 4. Any honest term list would be refused.
